notes.title: 🔥 First Bugfix Patch for Spin the Fire Demo ! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who has played the Spin the Fire demo! Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and I’ve been hard at work fixing bugs and making improvements. Today, I’m rolling out the first bugfix patch to smooth out the experience and add some extra polish.

A special thanks to the few youtubers who featured the game in its first week of release !

🔥 Patch Notes 🔥
✅ Tweaked some item descriptions for better clarity.
✅ Fixed chest reward skip button label.
✅ Fixed an issue where scrolling & right-clicking could trigger unwanted actions.
✅ Prevented card hovering during boss animations.
✅ Boss animations & cinematic overlay are now properly enabled again.
✅ Fixed the uncomplete fill bug where a slot would remain empty after a spin.
✅ Adjusted button scales to improve UI consistency.
🏆 Added the first 4 achievements—can you unlock them all?

What’s Next?
I’m continuing to fine-tune the game and would love to hear your thoughts! Let me know if you run into any issues or have suggestions for improvements. Your feedback is shaping Spin the Fire!

🔥 Play the demo & wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3528650/Spin_the_Fire/

Thanks for playing, and keep the fire burning! ❤️‍🔥

#SpinTheFire #IndieGame #Deckbuilder #Roguelike #GameDev
